text:
tess: Heads-up: fridge has a sour smell near the middle shelf. Anyone leave uncovered yogurt? :nose:

omar: guilty. my overnight lab sample yogurt went rogue. sorry! i'll toss it now.

pantry-bot: [fridge-check] temp=4.6C, open_events=3 in last 6h, potential_spill_detected near shelf_2.

julie: ew. thanks for owning up, omar. can we put a "covered only" sticker on the shelf?

mike: also we are out of coffee filters and half the mugs are chipped. willing to pick up replacements if folks chip in $5 each?

tess: sticker idea: yes. i'll print a bunch and tape. mike: go ahead with filters + 2 new mug sets. i'll Venmo for mine.

omar: sorry again. owe you a doughnut to apologize.

julie: accept on behalf of kitchen morale. :doughnut:

pantry-bot: scheduled: "fridge-deep-clean" by facilities on 2026-03-26T09:00Z

mike: sweet. i'll swing by the store at 17:00 to get filters and mugs. leaving a note on the magnet with receipt. anyone want a specific mug color?

tess: blue if you find it. thanks all. reminder: please cover leftovers and label date/name.
